_: Climb content pack 'Bouncy mushrooms' (owner 2026-10-06 night: Climb content ships as data under game/data/climb/, one pack per run; the owner session wires the loader, CI never edits climb.gd). Units are the tower's px like climb.gd (36 px = 1 m, +y up, x 0..960). scripts/games/climb_mushroom.gd reads this file: plan(n, plats) picks the gaps of band n that grow a cap, build(root, caps) draws them (stem, cap, spots, gills), step_vy(...) throws a body that falls onto a cap, `pose` is the Stick3D pose_request while thrown (stick3d_bounce.gd). tools/probe_mushroom.gd checks the plan, the launch, the squash and the pose.
name: Bouncy mushrooms

cap._: radius: half-width of the cap (px). depth: half-depth in z (px). height: stem + cap, the trampoline top above the root (px). launch: upward speed a body gets when it falls onto the top (px/s; apex = launch^2 / 2G = 252 px = 7 m, enough to clear the next hop's 92..140 px). sink: how far below the lower platform the root sits (px) so a short jump or a step off the edge falls onto the cap. squash: seconds of the cap's squash-and-spring. spots: cream dots on the cap. boing_hz: the spring tone's base pitch.

pieces._: From band 1, every 4th band (between the vent floors 3, 7, 11…): the two widest gaps between consecutive std hops (>= min_gap px edge to edge) each grow a cap in the middle of the gap, sink px below the lower hop. Rest bands have no std hops and get none.
